name: snack-attack-ultimate
description: Snack Attack - aventure, mode détente, nouveau menu, effets de lame et boutique cachée

scripts.prepare:web: npm run prepare:branding && npm run prepare:audio && node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && node scripts/patch-v2-relax.mjs
scripts.android:assets: npm run prepare:branding && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --assetPath resources --iconBackgroundColor '#51107f' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#2b0752' --splashBackgroundColor '#51107f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#2b0752'
scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android && npm run prepare:android-feedback && npm run android:assets
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && npm run prepare:android-feedback
